title: Zetta-Joule sector carousel
description: A dark band with a label and statement, then a snap-scrolling track of slides. Each slide is a photo plus a warm-grey card (dot and tag, light heading, paragraph, hairline and 'Learn more' link): side by side and bleeding off the right edge on desktop with a floating pale-blue arrow, stacked as one card per view with prev/next squares on phones. The track rises into view as you scroll.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (the track also scrolls by touch and trackpad)
the original also drifts each photo sideways; not rebuilt (a CSS scroll timeline cannot run inside a horizontal scroller)
